content: Melvin-Koushki says the Mafāḥiṣ was completed in 823/1420, perhaps in Isfahan or Yazd, and gives the two dates found in the earliest manuscripts: 1 Shaʿbān 823 (11 August 1420) in MS Landberg 146, or 19 Dhū l-Ḥijja 823 (25 December 1420) in MS Majlis 10196, the latter supported by an entry in a biographical dictionary.
